create_simulation_log: create a SimulationLog instance and add deduplicated log entries for simulation steps
query_entity_timeline: use AIAgentLogInterface to get a chronological timeline of all entries for a specific entity
search_log_entries: search simulation log entries by text query across all reconstructed content using AIAgentLogInterface
export_log_to_json: export a SimulationLog to a JSON string with content store and deduplicated entries
get_entity_action_context: get an entity action context including observations and prompt at a specific simulation step
